shorts.title: Korea's new capsule skincare: $36 SPF + a face-shaped pad
shorts.description:
mifarsoul (mfs) booth tour at a K-beauty expo.

• Super Fluid Sunshell: SPF50+ PA++++, no white cast, water resistant, $36
• Soothing Gel Pad: oval, 100% Tencel fabric, long-lasting hydration, after-sun recovery (the brand calls it the world's first oval-shaped pad)
• Collagen Spicule Pad: micro-spicule delivery, patented fabric, collagen firming care
• Super Collagen Shot Cream: collagen, PDRN, spicules, bursting capsules, $36
• Online store since July 2026: capsules $36, serum mists $38, free shipping over $65 (mifarsoul.com). Pads not online yet.

Verdict: fun shells with real SPF; a brand to watch, no reviews yet.
